caption.x:
"Later" isn't a time. Nothing in your day says later.

Give the habit a trigger:
After I ___, I will ___.

After my morning coffee → 10 flashcards
After I close my laptop → 20-min walk
After dinner → 10 pages

spoken: [hook] Later isn't a time. || When you say you'll do it later, there's nothing in your day that actually says later. So it just never comes. || [turn] So give the habit a trigger instead, something you already do every single day. || And use this sentence. After I do this, I will do that. || Like, after I pour my morning coffee, I'll go through ten Spanish flashcards. || After I close my laptop for the day, I'll go for a twenty minute walk. || After I finish dinner, I'll read ten pages of my book. || [land] So pick the one habit you keep putting off, and attach it to something you already do. Then write that sentence down tonight. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
